data.answer: Restores are tested every quarter. The most recent restore test was on 12 September 2026 and was completed in 2 hours 40 minutes, within the 4-hour RTO.
Nimbus Labs uses 9 sub-processors that may process customer data, including AWS and an email delivery provider. Customers receive 30 days' advance notice before a new sub-processor is added.
Tier 1 vendors are reviewed once a year, while Tier 2 vendors are reviewed every two years. Any vendor that suffers a security incident is reviewed immediately.
A background check covering identity, employment history, and education is completed before the start date for every employee, intern, and contractor.
All access is revoked within 4 hours of the person's exit time. Shared secrets are rotated within 2 business days, and company laptops are returned and wiped within 3 business days.

Customer data is stored in India by default in AWS Mumbai, but disaster recovery copies are held in Singapore. Customers needing all copies kept in India should discuss this with Nimbus Labs before signing.

The provided chunks do not mention a notification commitment for a suspected, unconfirmed security incident; they only state that affected customers are notified within 72 hours when a breach is confirmed.
The provided knowledge chunks do not mention encryption of data while it is in use, such as confidential computing, but only state that all customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256.

Incident response acknowledgement SLAs are 15 minutes for P1, 1 hour for P2, 1 business day for P3, and 3 business days for P4. Confirmed customer data breaches are notified within 72 hours, and reportable cyber incidents are reported to CERT-In within 6 hours.
